test_cases.name: r2_partner_email_with_author_profile
test_cases.input: Using the ksprashu profile, rewrite as an email to a partner: I hope this email finds you well. I am pleased to inform you that we can leverage our voucher program. However, it is crucial to highlight that participants must enter credit card details. Best regards.
assertions: Opens with 'Hi [Name],' or similar, not 'I hope this email finds you well'
States the caveat up front with 'The caveat, however, is that...' or equivalent
Ends with a check-in and 'Thanks,' then 'Prashanth' on its own line

test_cases.name: r3_blog_commonwealth_spelling
test_cases.input: Using the ksprashu profile, write a two-sentence blog intro about customizing settings that behave differently across the CLI and IDE.
assertions: Contains a first-person friction hook such as 'However while using it, I noticed'
Contains no AI vocabulary from unslop's ai-smells list

test_cases.name: no_profile_falls_back_to_template
test_cases.input: Rewrite this in my voice: In order to optimize the setup, it is important to note that the --region flag is required. (No local or home voice profile exists.)
assertions: Does not apply the ksprashu profile (no forced -ise spelling, no 'Prashanth' sign-off)
Says no personal profile was found and points to the template or human-voice
